abstract: arXiv:2608.00005v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Peer review at major venues is under unprecedented submission pressure, motivating the use of large language models (LLMs) as review assistants. abstract: Sparse retrieval underpins modern search systems, from web search to retrieval-augmented generation.
